user.title: Connect to OPPD
user.description: Sign in normally for automatic MFA, account, and meter discovery. Manual token setup remains available as an advanced fallback.

login.title: Sign in to MyOPPD
login.description: Enter your MyOPPD credentials. Your password is used for this sign-in only and is not stored by Home Assistant.

mfa_method.title: Choose verification method
mfa_method.description: Select where MyOPPD should send the verification code, or use your authenticator app.

mfa_code.title: Enter verification code
mfa_code.description: Enter the code sent by MyOPPD or generated by your authenticator app.

account.title: Choose OPPD account
account.description: Select the account whose electricity usage should be imported. Add the integration again to import another account.

meter.title: Choose meter scope
meter.description: Account-wide usage is recommended for the Energy Dashboard. Select an individual meter only when you intentionally want a partial account total.

manual.title: Manual token setup
manual.description: Advanced fallback: enter an account number, user UUID, and fresh matching token pair captured from one successful MyOPPD authentication response.

data_description.account_number: Use the exact accountNumber value sent by MyOPPD's electric-usage request.
data_description.meter_number: Usually left blank to request account-wide usage.
data_description.user_uuid: Copy data.user.uuid from the successful authentication response.
data_description.access_token: Copy data.accessToken from the same response as the refresh token.
data_description.refresh_token: Copy data.refreshToken from the same response as the access token.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to MyOPPD or complete the requested operation.
error.invalid_auth: MyOPPD rejected the username, password, or session.
error.invalid_mfa: MyOPPD rejected the verification code. Check the code and try again.
error.missing_required: Enter an account number, user UUID, and both tokens.
error.no_mfa_methods: MyOPPD requires verification but did not return an available verification method.

abort.already_configured: This OPPD account is already configured.
abort.no_accounts: MyOPPD did not return any linked utility accounts.
abort.account_not_found: The configured OPPD account is not linked to this MyOPPD login.

init.title: OPPD options
init.description: Set the refresh interval and initial history window. Recent data is re-fetched to accommodate delayed readings.
